Prophecy: The Kingdom Shall Be Taken and Given to a Fruit-Bearing Nation
ProphecySummary: Jesus predicts that the kingdom of God shall be taken from the chief priests and Pharisees who rejected him and given to a nation bringing forth its fruits.
Fulfillment: Partially fulfilled: the kingdom's stewardship passed to a new people, Jew and Gentile believers bearing fruit, while the full fruitfulness of that people is still unfolding.
